text:
Alex P: Heads up — staging image push for service-x was quarantined by the provenance guard during publish. KMS annotation mismatch on the manifest (sha256:abc123def...).

deploy-bot: publish blocked: provenance-guard.ERROR KMS_ANNOTATION_MISMATCH for repo=redwood/service-x:staging-20260320 (manifest sha256:abc123def...)

Maria G: on it. which region?

Alex P: us-east-1. CI finished and push kicked, but provenance attestation has different kms_key_id than our signing KMS.

Samir R: probable cause: recent KMS key rotation for signing service. We rotated yesterday but deploybot's attestor wasn't updated.

Jamie L: if attestor not matching, staging should not get promoted. Suggest we pin prod to previous digest and hold the canary.

Maria G: agree. action items:
- hold canary/promote in release pipeline
- pin prod to sha256:ff9e77... from yesterday
- regenerate attestation with current key or roll back KMS change

Alex P: I'm going to attempt a local cosign verify to see attestation metadata.

Alex P: ```
$ cosign verify-attestation --type provenance ghcr.io/redwood/service-x@sha256:abc123def
Error: annotation kms_key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333:key/old-key-id not in deploybot-allowlist
```

Samir R: yep old-key-id. We have a mapping in infra-kms repo. Deploybot didn't pick new mapping. I can push a quick patch to deploybot to accept the rotated key for staging only.

Jamie L: timeline? we have a small change window at 02:00 UTC but product wants canary sooner. Recommend hold until deploybot patch lands + a manual attestation re-run.

Maria G: I'll update release notes with the hold and plan: "staging publish quarantined due to KMS annotation mismatch; canary postponed pending deploybot attestor update; prod pinned to previous digest."

Alex P: tagging ops: @Samir R and @Jamie L will coordinate the deploybot patch + manual reprovision. If patch takes >30m we'll pin and schedule a re-run in the next change window.

Samir R: pushing patch to infra/deploybot now, small acceptlist change. Testing locally then CI.

infra-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch infra/deploybot/kms-acceptlist-fix (build 4821) — status: running

Maria G: I've added a short note to the release doc and Slack release thread. Also added a line to the incident log.

deploy-bot: manual republish allowed by @Samir R: re-queueing provenance attestation job for sha256:abc123def in us-east-1

Alex P: once republish succeeds, we'll verify cosign attestation and then decide whether to proceed with canary. If it still fails, we do the pin.

Samir R: CI green, patch merged. I'm rerunning attestation now.

deploy-bot: provenance attestation completed: SUCCESS for sha256:abc123def (kms_key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333:key/new-key-id)

Alex P: verified with cosign locally. Good to proceed with canary.

Jamie L: proceeding with canary schedule in 10m. Maria, please keep release notes updated with final decision.

Maria G: done — release notes updated and change log entry added. Closing thread after canary completes. :white_check_mark:
